QuestInfo.name: Becoming a Blade Recruit
QuestInfo.0: Hm, so you want to know how to become a great Dual Blade?
QuestInfo.1:
Becoming a great Dual Blade requires you to obtain a Mirror of Insight. #bGo to the Marble Room and strike the Glass Marble. Double-click to break the marble.#k If you are worthy, the Mirror of Insight will be yours.



#i4032616# #t4032616#  #b#c4032616#/1#k

#rTip: If you leave the Marble Room, you will be unable to complete the quest. If that happens, abandon the quest and try again.
QuestInfo.2: You have become a Blade Recruit. You're looking more Dual Blade-ish already!
